title: News From Yasmin
gist_ar: إيميل من ياسمين بتحكي فيه اللي حصل معاها مؤخرًا.
text:
Hi Karim,

I haven't written for a long time, so here is my news. A lot has happened lately. I have just finished my first year at university, and I have already started a part-time job in a bookshop. I have been there since March.

The biggest change is that we moved to a new flat in February. I lost my old room, which I loved, but the new area is much quieter. So far I have met three of the neighbours and they seem kind.

I have improved my English a lot this year, because I decided to read one article every morning. I didn't enjoy it at the beginning, but recently it has become a habit. Last week I even won a small prize in a writing competition at the university!

What about you? Has anything changed since we last met? Write soon and tell me everything.

Yasmin

questions.q: How long has she worked in the bookshop?
What does she say about the new area?
How did she improve her English?
options: She moved to a new flat
She read one article every morning
